before: An accepted column deletion that took every cell of a row left the row in the items, so the room drew and saved an empty row.
after: The settle step marks gone a row that compose took out with the removed cells, as the engine removes it.
reason: Change messages, the change log, the manifest fields and the Yjs format do not change: every client runs the same settle step after the same decision change. A room admits only clients of its own code version.
